description: Redesign GalleryPage.tsx and ContactPage.tsx with cinematic glassmorphic UI, then commit all changes and push to main.
steps: Rewrite src/pages/GalleryPage.tsx: (a) Fixed background https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1470071459604-3b5ec3a7fe05?w=1920&q=80 with dark overlay. (b) Photo gallery grid with glass card wrappers. (c) Loading/error/empty states in glass panels. (d) White/slate-300 text, emerald accents. (e) Preserve the fetch from /api/gallery and all bilingual text.

Rewrite src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: (a) Fixed background https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1477346611705-65d1883cee1e?w=1920&q=80 with dark overlay. (b) Contact details (Principal: 9423864391, Clerk: 7666971183, Email: hmpathraj22@gmail.com) in glass cards. (c) Google Maps embed in glass wrapper. (d) Address in glass panel. (e) Contact form in glass panel. (f) White/slate-300 text, emerald accents. (g) Preserve all bilingual data.
Run 'source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && npm run lint' and fix any errors.
Run 'source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && npm run build' and fix any errors.
Commit all changes with meaningful commit message(s) and push to main.
